items.title: Cosimo Matassa Interview, 1993-11-01
items.q: My Love is Strong. Which has. Jimmy Clanton. Cosmo Mitassa. And Earl King. As writers.

ctx.x: But, okay, Earl King. Darling, honey, angel, child. Yeah, well. What can you say?
Earl King has always been what he is. He's just got these fantastic lyrics.

Okay. And, of course, Van Broussard, which was probably a Cajun. Cajun, yeah. Got it. Yeah. Okay. So you didn't, so this wasn't a big moneymaker for you. No. The Rex label, the Rex label wasn't a big moneymaker. But you attribute that more to Johnny Vincent.
